task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the paymentsign resting on angled base up and turn its QR code toward you using the left arm.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架后拾取位于倾斜底座上的付款标志，并使用左臂将其二维码转向您。
